The NHS-mediated titer reduction of VSV-GP was dependent on activation of the classical complement pathway, mainly by natural IgM antibodies against xenoantigens such as galactose-α-(1,3)-galactose (α-Gal) or N -glycolylneuraminic acid (Neu5Gc) expressed on nonhuman production cell lines.
